info.name: Boudica Dashboard
info.summary: Domain usage and security dashboard for Boudica admins.
info.description: Boudica Dashboard is a Nextcloud app that surfaces the same admin metrics as the Boudica Admin Portal (overall usage, most-prompted questions, security-risk flags, a 30-day usage timeline, and top users by volume) directly inside Nextcloud, backed by Chart.js.
info.author: You
